Painted panel accent: #E5BD24.
Isolate on a perfectly uniform solid #FF00FF background, without gradient. Leave clear space all around.
No driver, no people inside vehicles, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no perspective, no cast shadows, no cropped subject, no decorative ground.
